Overview.Name: Sirikonda pallavi
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Meal_1: Option 1: Idli (2) & sambar (1 cup) & paneer cubes (50 g)
Option 2: Vegetable dosa (1) & egg omelette (2 eggs)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & dal (light) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer stir fry (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since you prefer minimal cooking, choose simple meals like idli, dosa, paneer or eggs that take less time.
Because fried foods are a craving, choose pan cooked eggs or chicken instead of deep fried snacks.
Keep lunch slightly stronger to maintain steady energy through the day.
Stress eating can increase hunger, so keep roasted makhana ready as a simple snack.
Maintain a fixed routine to support stable energy and digestion.
